ov: Land gastropods with no shell, or only a tiny internal one. “Slug” isn’t one group: losing the shell evolved many separate times, so different slugs aren’t closely related to each other.

why.ac: Many are most active at night or after rain, when the ground is damp.

df: Plants, including garden flowers, fruit and vegetables; some eat fungi and slime moulds.

cf.tip: A snail has a coiled shell big enough to pull into. A slug has no shell, or only a tiny one.

fx: Without a shell, a slug can squeeze under bark and stones where a snail can’t go.
